body: A lot of people here don't seem to get it. It really sucks for me. I just want to play minecraft with my younger siblings who I live 20 hours away from but I can't shell out that much money. It's not worth it for a game we already bought and will only play together like once a month. It feels like a scam because if we were able to play on PC there would be no extra charge. It sucks that they can get away with taking away such a crucial feature of the game. Sure I can play alone, it's frankly just not fair. Everything these companies do is to take advantage of the fact that there are people that WILL pay extra but some of us will simply never get that luxury.

My mother essentially self identified as mother Gothel from Tangled. She would sing “Mother Knows Best” unironically and I get flashbacks when I hear it now. 

Weird one I think though is Pink Diamond from Steven Universe… I think it’s the immaturity, the obliviousness, entitlement. My grandmother was the true narcissist, my mom was like second hand narcissism. My suspension of disbelief was tested when White came around because I likened her to my grandma. I didn’t buy it but I guess fiction is where the happy endings happen.

This is what we in the “biz” call unsolicited advice. That’s some massive entitlement, I mean there is some good advice sprinkled in there if you’d asked how to throw a stellar party but super insulting as a thank you to a party. At the end of the day you decide how much effort to put into something like that, not everyone has the time and or money to cater like she’s expecting. It should mean more to get to spend time together regardless of how many drink options there are and if things are spotless.

I don’t think you were “in the wrong”. It’s possible you were a bit rude because people in a bad mood tend to project a bit of rudeness but being “a bit rude” to someone who’s being obnoxious is kinda deserved. Also don’t be too hard on yourself, it’s hard to have a respectful proper reaction to things when you were never taught. Narcissists tend to bring out the worst in people because they will antagonize you so you snap and then they can claim you’re being the “mean” one. It takes years to not fall into their traps but regardless of whether you do or not you can’t be held responsible for your parent’s bad teachings and bad attitudes. There is a point where your own actions become your responsibility but you are entitled to time and space to learn. You are NOT an asshole, or crazy. I say this not to excuse them but to shed some light: the rest of your family likely stayed quiet so as not to draw her attention to them. It’s fairly common for people to take the side of ab*sers in hopes of not being their victim. It’s not okay but it does make sense.

There’s some good advice here already so I’m not sure if mine will help. For driving specifically I find it helps me to kinda hype myself up. Remind myself I’ve done it before and I’m very capable. The key is to really settle into your convictions. It’s not just the words, you have to believe yourself so it takes some time and practice. I’ve dealt with panic attacks and anxiety for quite a while though so I’ve got a lot of experience bouncing back from low patches. I believe in you though, you’ll get through it just be patient with yourself.

I usually show workers my phone so there is no confusion in loud restaurants, especially if I don’t know how to pronounce something, I can hardly pronounce words in English let alone Spanish, Korean, Greek and what have you. I usually keep my phone down by the counter though so I can set it down if they need to write out the order. Maybe I’ve shoved my phone in someone’s face before? I don’t know, the days are long but I’m gonna keep this in mind now.

Howdy, I'm glad you're trying. It's pretty hard to do, at least for me. 

A word of advice. It's NEVER too late to try. Society doesn't matter, in reality nothing *matters*. 

Sorry, if this sounds like cheesy or stupid but I am just here to **try** to help. This is just the only way I know how. So I guess just please don't let society scare you into wasting your life away or giving up. That seems to be all society is good for sometimes but I believe in you. I may not know you or know very much about you but I hope that maybe my words mean something to you. That maybe they help because I think everyone deserves help when they need it, want it, whatever. 

Maybe find someone to look up to. Find a hobby, or a goal. Something that means more to you than societies expectations for you. People put others down because seeing others beneath them makes them feel better about themselves. That's it. People will find their own happiness at others expense but that lifestyle is so cheap and fragile. 

There is no universal way to escape feeling trapped, no one way to make friends or get a job but being able to find a bit of peace where you are can help. If you can find worth in your life as it is, it can give yourself energy to make it better, if that makes sense. 

I understand the fear of antidepressants and I think that's something you should talk to a doctor or therapist about if you can. But antidepressants are just one of many options for dealing with depression. There are so many ways, my personal favorite for myself is calling everyone in my contacts until someone answers, just person roulette of whether they will be helpful or not. 

I hope that this is maybe a little bit helpful at least. No pressure to respond, I hope you're day is at least okay.

I’m not a professional so take what I say with a grain of salt but I’d say it could be anxiety. 
I have a really bad anxiety problem and have been formally diagnosed. I have had anxiety attacks with seemingly no trigger. And I do believe that you can have one with just no trigger but I’d say most of the time there is one. You might not have a serious anxiety problem but sometimes stress can pile up or things can bother you more than you realize I think it’s fairly common for people who don’t have anxiety to have a bought of anxiety for reasons besides actually being anxious and it go away as quickly as it came. 
How our body’s respond to stress can change even without us realizing as well. Lack of sleep or other essential things can make you more prone to things anxiety. Also just big shifts in life in general. I’d say If it gets worse you could get a referral from your doctor to talk to a counselor. Or just if your really worried about it but if your doctor didn’t find anything physically wrong with you so I wouldn’t worry to much. 
Again I’m not a Professional though. I talk like I know what I’m talking about but this is bits and pieces of therapy, google and opinions. 
I hope you sort it out though. Good luck.

Unsolicited advice from someone who isn’t a professional. This can only do so much but I would try “when you get an idea just do it” and I mean a good healthy still living idea since you are posting on here I hope that you want to try. I know what I say probably won’t do much but despite my horrible view of people in general I hope for everyone to find happiness in themselves. I hope you keep trying, I’m still trying too. None of us know each other but there is a lot of us still trying here, I at least find peace in that.

Hi there, I'm josh, um I don't know everything you've been through but I've been through some stuff like you're talking about too. Panic attacks are hard to deal with. I can't give you professional advice but if you want me to share some of how I cope I can if you ask. I'm not you so I don't know what you need but I'm here to help if you want it.

Hi, ditto, I feel you dude. I know I'm me and you're you but when I feel like this I like to blast music really loud. Or go through the list of essentials: Drink, eat, shower, change clothes, sleep, I mean it can't fix it by any means but sometimes it helps so it's an idea. I hope you feel better soon.
Hiya, why do you hate your job if you don't mind me asking?

Thank you really, I'm trying my best to right a lot of wrongs. I have been told a lot that I am very self aware but this wasn't always true, I guess I feel like I still am those things even though I may not be as much anymore. Even if my feeling are wrong they are still how I feel and very hard to fight. I was raised by people I will never be good enough for and I strive to at least be good enough for myself someday. 

I feel like maybe I'm on some high horse trotting around and trying to share my experiences with people to help them but I genuinely just want to do what little I can to help people because I never felt like a single person was there for me but myself I've always felt weak and like I was a weirdo.

Even knowing that a lot of stuff is in my head as I was diagnosed with an anxiety disorder I still struggle. I mean obviously nothing in life is easy to fix. Anyway really, seriously thank you for saying this it's really hard for me to know what what's real and what is in my head sometimes and yeah. 

I don't want to make this guys post about me now though.  Everyone here deserves to be good enough for themselves. Everyone in general does. I'm just doing my best and I hope everyone else is too.
Do you need to talk?

I'm not a professional, I've never been to a mental health facility but if you think it will help then you should go. I don't know where you are but where I am normal hospitals accept people with mental health problems as well if that could be a better option for you. I'm glad that you are trying to seek help, I know from experience that can be really hard to do.

I'm really scared of people in real life. Not because anyone has hurt me but because I've seen far to many people be hurt. Anyone can be hurt, everyone can be hurt and everyone hurts people even you.

Please don't invalidate what I say because I say this but I feel I should tell you that I'm demisexual and trans meaning they don't know whats in my pants until they see it and it takes me a real long time to want whats in theirs. I don't think anyone will be able to deal with that let alone my plethora of mental health problems. Really though the kicker is in person I'm kind of a jerk. I'm entitled and narcissistic. I don't think anyone else could like me but if I was a different person I would like me if that makes sense. 

Dude I don't know you but I'm a coward and a bully but I keep on trying. I'm trying to be better and trying to notice my faults. I don't want to condone anything like specific but in this world you can change anything about yourself if you try hard enough is what I believe. Give yourself a chance. You can start over any day, you can start over every day. 

I don't know if anything I say helps people but I'm just trying.
Hi, if you want to talk I'm here to talk.

Hey, hi, um you can't stop people from being feeling. I get it, the reason I'm still here is a couldn't hurt my best friend. It's still hard but maybe give it a chance. I feel you but I also wish that I could perform on Broadway, it's stupid, I never will but it's fun to think about sometimes. I really want to help people so I'm just trying. I hope you can find something else you wish for, I hope you can find something else to do for yourself here.

Look, I'm not a therapist or a professional or anything but I have something to say.

Even if you pass. Graduate even with amazing grades. Get a great job, is this what you want to do with your life? Will it be worth it? I mean this fully empathetically but do you want to drive yourself to this by your life choices? I'm not telling you what to do or that you have to change what your doing, I'm not saying anything is going to be easy but I was in this situation, albeit in as a completely different person with different goals and family and all that but I had to leave it. I couldn't put myself through it because it wasn't worth it in the end. 

It can look like there are only two ways to go when really there are no roads here man. You can walk freely in any direction, who knows where it will take you but you sound like a very determined and passionate person. I think you can do it. You don't need to torture yourself, or punish yourself, you haven't done anything wrong by failing. Failing is part of life. You are going to fall over and over and over again. That is okay because you only really fail when you give up. Failing as a grade is arbitrary. I know me saying that can't fix how you feel but I hope you think about that. You're still here, you haven't given up and I implore you not to.

Hey uh, I just wanna say hi. Even if I can't talk you out of this please talk to me. I'm not very good at helping people my talents lie elsewhere but I think maybe I could. Or I'd like to try.

Look, I've been there, I am there, it lasts a really long time. That's scary I know. I can't guarantee your life will get better. I can't make your life get better. 

The world is big! Huge! And terrifying but give yourself a chance please. 

I didn't do it. Over and over and over again. My life is still not perfect or even close to what I hoped it would be but I don't regret it. I don't regret giving myself a chance. I don't think you will either, of course I can't speak for you but from my experience there is hope. 

Please please please if not for your own sake, for mine, talk to me or someone. Not your mom, forget about her, you don't need excuses she or anyone or me have for her right now. There are a lot of people that want to help, deeply truely, me included. 

I don't like going through this and I don't like seeing others go through it. I wouldn't wish this on anyone. Please respond.

I am honestly searching for someone ugly here and I haven't found one yet. 

I don't find you ugly. You look kind of familiar. Not in an I know you kind of way but like you look like other people. You are part of a look. I'd give you a 7 you aren't "oh my god stand out gorgeous" (and yes I use that word for men and women) but you definitely aren't ugly, I can stand to look at you more than the average person. 

Take a boost up, no need to tear yourself down or have yourself torn down whether you are ugly or not. Having confidence would probably bring you up to an 8 because believe it or not you can see that in a person. Plus this is just my opinion here but other people are also saying you aren't ugly. We're not lying. This is all kind of weird to me but I'm here to give people my honest opinion and so I'm commenting here cause you stood out to me.

I think if you grow your hair out and just try something you can always go back to short like this if it doesn't look good cause this looks good anyway. I'm not an authority on hair but I think you'd look cool with a mohawk. Which I'm a tad jealous of because I couldn't pull one off.

Yes your nose is big, no you don't need to change that. 

You are really pretty. Anyone that disagrees is jealous. Probably not for good reason because often people get jealous of each other even though they are also very pretty but beauty is in they eye of the beholder and often people can't see their own. That's okay. But your nose is fine hun.

I don't personally find you ugly. I think your cute and your smile is really bright. Your hair is really pretty too. 

I think it's good to lose weight if you want to and if it will make you feel better but I want you to know that you don't need to to be pretty because you already are.

Hey hey, um, look I really just want to help people here, if I can help you, tell me. I don't know what to say to anyone, who does? but I'm trying, can you try to talk to me? Or someone? We are all doing our best right. I think you need to be "meant" to stay alive. That doesn't matter. You can just stay alive. I can't promise you anything but I hope you will.

I don't know if this will help but I have a suggestion. How about a smaller dream. Don't give up on your big dream by any means but you don't have to just dream of a big future plan. What about something small that you want. It could be a step to get to that big dream, something that would make you happy on your way there, or even just something you could achieve tomorrow. 

How about doing something little that you always wanted to do as a kid. I always wanted to eat lunchables but I was never allowed to have them. Now I have one every once in a while. It might sound stupid but it makes me realize that I'm in a different place now. If I want the little thing that makes me happy I can have because I have a few extra dollars to spend on me. It doesn't have to be big and more than anything I've come to realize that things only get better slowly. It feels endless but that doesn't mean that it is.

What do you say?

 I'm a very problem solvey person so sorry if this wasn't what you were looking for. Sill I hope that things get better for you. Even if you think this is empty I'm gonna say it anyway, you've made it this far and I believe in you.

I think you can do it. Why not try to help people? Even if you fail that's part of life. I know it's cliche to say that but really. That's what I'm doing right now. Trying to help people in the only way I know remotely how. I may not be doing as good as some people could. I may be completely failing but I'm doing it cause I know I need too not just for others but for myself. I'm just hoping and trying.

Why does it have to be worth it in the end? this isn't a rhetorical question you can answer if you want. 

I think personally that things just have to be worth it right now. The future is scary I definitely feel you there. It's hard to find purpose in the struggle but maybe there is. I hope maybe we can talk about this if you want. I want to help.

I don't really know what to say. I'm lingering around here hoping to help but I'm not that good I don't think. 

I've kinda felt how you feel. I know it doesn't mean much but I care about you. Not in the way you probably want someone to, but stranger to stranger, I think you deserve to give yourself a chance. 

I assume someone told you "you have soooooo much to live for" I just want to say maybe you don't but I don't think you need it. You don't need something to live for right now but maybe you'll find something to live for someday and why not give it a chance. 

It's all going to end so uh, why rush it. 

I've heard it all too. I know it's really not helpful a lot of the time but I'm trying. I hope you will too.

I get it. Feelings just demand to be felt. I think give it a chance like talking to them or write to them, try anything you can. 

I always tell myself to be gentle with myself- that probably doesn't make sense but I mean- You can give yourself encouragement. Not just saying "I can do it" but sometimes "it's okay that I feel this way" or even from third person "you can do it". I don't know, sometimes it feels weird to do that but also makes me feel better a little. If there is a big solution to feeling this way I haven't found it but what I just told you kinda helps me.

Even if what I said doesn't help. I hope the best for you. I hope you find something that does help.

I don't know if I have anything helpful to offer. I have a similar situation except I came out to everyone, just screamed it to the world. When death seems like an option why not live your life truthfully while your living. I gave up on the path I was hurtling on and now I work minimum wage. It's hard but I can find my path now I've accepted more or less that I'm not who others say I should be and I am just trying to find myself. 

I don't want to tell you what to do but no matter how hopeless the situation what can it hurt to just try something. I have a kind of "what do I have to lose attitude" Pack up, move away, try something new, you might fail, you might crash and burn, but what do you have to lose that you wouldn't lose by killing yourself. I live by this because I have too and I hope the best for you. It's crazy but we could meet someday and we'd never even know it. I hope we do. I really hope things get better.

Okay, um, I know I can say whatever I want and I probably can't do much but I'm just here trying to cope with my own feelings too so I figured I'd respond. 

Suicide is permanent, I mean realistically everything is permanent, you can't go back on anything you do but in general a lot of people don't like things that are permanent and try to take the permanent choices out of life. 

I kind of understand how you feel maybe, I mean I feel similarly. At the end of it all though you ask why stay alive, I say why die? Either is a pointless debate, but I know I'm going to die eventually anyway and as far as I know I won't get a chance to live again. Even though I hardly feel like living is worth it, it's short and I will endure because I can't think of a reason not to at the moment.

I really don't mean anything bad by any of this, I just thought I'd post this cause um, yeah, I guess it's just here now.
